name: Dust devils

unlocks.name: To Dust You Shall Return
unlocks.notes: Number of dust devils assigned is increased to 200-250.

unlocks.name: I Wildy More Slayer
unlocks.notes: Free toggleable reward that controls whether Krystilia can assign dust devils as a Wilderness task; toggled off she will not assign it.

variantInfo.name: Dust devil
notes: Standard Dust devils are assigned after 65 Slayer, 70 combat, and starting Desert Treasure I.
The Smoke Dungeon and Wilderness Slayer Cave versions are level 93 and give 105 Slayer XP.
The Catacombs of Kourend version is level 110, has 130 Hitpoints, hits harder, and gives 130 Slayer XP.
Dust devils use a ranged melee attack: it is treated as melee, but rolls against the player's ranged defence.
A facemask or Slayer helmet is required; without one, Dust devils rapidly damage the player and drain combat stats.
Dust devils have very low Defence and a 35% air elemental weakness.
They are popular for Ancient Magicks burst and barrage tasks in multicombat areas.

variantInfo.name: Choke devil
notes: Superior Slayer monster that can spawn from Dust devils after purchasing Bigger and Badder for 50 Slayer reward points.
Requires the same facemask or Slayer helmet protection as regular Dust devils.
Uses ranged melee, has 300 Hitpoints, a max hit of 24, and gives 3000 Slayer XP.
Choke devils have no defensive bonuses and a 25% air elemental weakness.
Konar assignments guarantee a Brimstone key drop from Choke devils.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: The Catacombs of Kourend spot is multicombat, cannon-restricted, and the default recommendation for most non-Konar, non-Krystilia assignments.
Dust devils here use the Catacombs drop table, including ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
The area is easy to access and supports burst, barrage, chinchompa, and safespot play.

locationComparison.name: Wilderness Slayer Cave
notes: The Wilderness Slayer Cave Dust devils are in level 25-28 Wilderness and are only relevant when assigned by Krystilia or when the player accepts PvP risk.
The multicombat layout allows cannoning and Ancient Magicks, and the monsters use the Wilderness Slayer Cave drop table.
Do not bring any items you are unwilling to lose; blighted ancient ice sacks can reduce rune costs.

locationComparison.name: Smoke Dungeon
notes: The Smoke Dungeon is remote and usually quieter than the Catacombs, with task-only multicombat Dust devils to the west guarded by Dusty Aliv.
The task-only western multicombat area cannot use a dwarf multicannon.
The remaining Smoke Dungeon Dust devil rooms are single-way combat and allow cannoning.
Killing a Dust devil in the Smoke Dungeon while wearing a Slayer helmet is required for the Hard Desert Diary.

taskNotes: Dust devils require 65 Slayer, 70 combat, and having started Desert Treasure I before they can be assigned.
A facemask, Slayer helmet, or Slayer helmet (i) is required; without protection, Dust devils deal rapid damage and drain Attack, Strength, Ranged, Magic, Agility, Defence, and Prayer stats.
Their attack is a ranged melee attack: it is considered melee and Protect from Melee works, but the accuracy roll uses the player's ranged defence.
Dust devils have very low Defence and a 35% air elemental weakness, while Choke devils have a 25% air weakness.
burst and barrage spells are the standard high-XP approach because Catacombs, Smoke Dungeon task-only, and Wilderness Slayer Cave locations support multicombat stacking.
Chinchompas and other area attacks can also be used, but Ancient Magicks is the task page's main equipment and method focus.
Catacombs of Kourend is highly recommended for most tasks because it is easy to reach, multicombat, and uses the Catacombs drop table.
Smoke Dungeon is quieter and has a large Dust devil population, but its task-only multicombat area cannot use a cannon while the single-way rooms can.
Wilderness Slayer Cave offers cannonable multicombat Dust devils and blighted supply options, but carries player-killer risk.
Choke devil superior spawns require the Bigger and Badder unlock and should be handled with the same facemask or Slayer helmet protection.
Killing a Dust devil in the Smoke Dungeon while wearing a Slayer helmet is part of the Hard Desert Diary.
recommendedMethod: Use a Slayer helmet or facemask and burst or barrage stacked Dust devils, usually in the Catacombs of Kourend. Use Smoke Dungeon for Konar locks or quieter task-only multicombat, remembering that the task-only area cannot be cannoned, and use Wilderness Slayer Cave only when accepting PvP risk or following a Krystilia assignment.
